purpose: Compare the latest-v1 zero-residual start, the checkpoint before two additional fresh PPO updates, and the checkpoint after those updates on an unused matched schedule.

exploratory_gates.continue_exact_configuration: Post must have positive paired net wins versus both pre and zero, with no seat or opponent paired net regression.
exploratory_gates.runtime_safety: Every arm must have 32 clean terminals, zero action errors, and zero max-step hits.
exploratory_gates.policy_effect: Report action-trace and argmax changes; no post-hoc hard minimum is used.
exploratory_gates.failure_scope: Failure does not reject RL; it only withholds support for continuing the exact same update configuration.

duplicate_control.required_equality: Same 32 keys, terminal rewards, decision counts, encoded state vectors, action vectors, effect features, behavior action order, final actions, and final probabilities. Raw-observation hashes are excluded because they include run-variant material outside the encoded policy input.

required_checks: Recompute wins and losses from terminal_reward.
Require 32 unique opponent-seat-seed keys per arm and identical key sets.
Require 32 clean terminals, zero action errors, and zero max-step hits per arm.
Report paired outcome changes for zero-to-post and pre-to-post.
Report action-trace changes and probability movement only on state-and-action-order-aligned PPO decisions.
decision_question: Did the two additional 32-game fresh-rollout PPO updates improve matched local strength enough to continue the same update configuration, or should the next iteration alter learning/exploration or credit design?
